# SpineGpuSkinning

> GPU skinning for spine-unity 4.2 SkeletonAnimation on Unity 2022.3+ / URP 14. One component, editor bake, automatic CPU fallback. Agent skills ship in Skills~/.

This folder is a Unity plugin. When it lives under Assets/, Unity ignores `Skills~/`. Agents should start at AGENTS.md, then load the matching skill. Do not invent APIs from older README copies.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): router, hard rules, current contract
- [Use the plugin](Skills~/gpuspine-use-plugin/SKILL.md): integrate, fallback, custom shader / RenderPass, runtime switch
- [Develop the plugin](Skills~/gpuspine-develop-plugin/SKILL.md): architecture, bake semantics, buffers, verification
- [README.md](README.md): human overview and example

## Contracts

- [CPU fallback rules](Skills~/gpuspine-use-plugin/references/fallback-rules.md)

- [C# / HLSL layouts](Skills~/gpuspine-develop-plugin/references/buffer-layouts.md)
- [1:1 bake semantics](Skills~/gpuspine-develop-plugin/references/skinning-semantics.md)
